thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx rate on inference-prod (route: /v1/generate). Alert triggered at 2024-06-15T18:40:32Z. Paging oncall.

sara: Seeing 20% 5xx and steady CPU on node-gpupool-3. Canary pods in namespace inference-canary are CrashLoopBackOff.

matt: I'm oncall, looking now. @vinh can you pull logs from the canary pods?

vinh: grabbing logs. short snippet shows repeated panic in loader: `failed to mmap model.bin: file too small` and also `OOMKilled` trace in one replica.

ali: HPA scaled up a bit earlier, but minReplicas is 1. Looks like during the rollout the canary got a bad config for the init container that mounts the model from PVC.

sara: that matches — manifest change in the rollout removed the `volumeMount` path for model-cache. I think init container exits immediately which leaves main container uninitialized and causes crashloop.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @carol at 2024-06-15T18:34:12Z - rollout id r-2024-06-15-34. Canary target: 2 pods. Canary probe configured: readiness 5s, liveness 10s.

matt: immediate plan: pause rollout, revert canary manifest, and if needed kill the feature flag. Who can run `kubectl` in the prod cluster now?

sara: I can. Suggest sequence: 1) Pause the deployment controller (set rollout pause/abort), 2) revert canary by `kubectl rollout undo`, 3) if that doesn't stabilize, toggle feature flag `ff/encoder-async` to off to force fallback model.

vinh: I'll attempt to revert canary first. Running:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=12
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-api
```

vinh: rollout undo accepted, now waiting. One pod became Running but readiness failing.

ali: I'm seeing HPA spikes: targetCPU 80% briefly hit, new pods getting OOMKilled during startup due to init container mis-mount — need to cordon node-gpupool-3 to stop scheduling until we confirm root cause.

matt: Do not cordon the whole pool yet — that might reduce capacity below SLA. Instead mark problematic node unschedulable for new pods only: `kubectl cordon node-gpupool-3`? Any objections?

carol: Agree with cordoning just the node. I'll coordinate with infra to drain gracefully if we need to evict.

sara: cordon executed.

oncall-bot: @matt is now primary oncall. Handoff noted. Reminder: Escalate to SRE if customer impact > 10% affected.

matt: Customer impact: internal dashboards show increased latency and 5xx affecting ~12% of inference calls from two regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Marking P1 because customer-facing LLM endpoints degrade product UX.

incident-bot: Severity set to P1 due to >10% customer impact.

vinh: After undo, canary pods are still failing readiness. Logs show the init container tries to mount `/mnt/models` but PVC is Bound to a different path (looks like a typo in the new manifest). Reapplying old manifest should fix.

sara: Reapplying old manifest now `kubectl apply -f manifests/inference-api-v11.yaml` which has correct volumeMounts.

sara: applied. Rolling update triggered to revision 13.

deploy-bot: Rollout to revision 13 started. Canary target 2 -> 2.

vinh: New pods started and readiness probes passing. No more CrashLoopBackOff seen.

ali: HPA normalized, CPU drop to baseline, no further OOMs. Good sign.

matt: Toggle feature flag `ff/encoder-async` to off as a safety net (still off now) — doing via feature-flagging service CLI.

matt: `ffctl set ff/encoder-async false --env=prod --note="safety during rollout"`

carol: Confirmed flag flipped. Telemetry shows traffic now using fallback encoder model.

sara: Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 20% -> 2% over last 7 minutes. Latency return to baseline for 95th perc.

oncall-bot: Noted mitigation steps: pause/revert, cordon node, reapply manifest, toggle feature flag. Please add runbook links and follow-up actions.

matt: Raising post-incident actions: 1) Add schema validation to CI for manifests to catch missing volumeMounts. 2) Add canary preflight check to validate PVC mount paths. 3) Revisit HPA behavior during rollout to avoid aggressive scaling on initial failures.

vinh: Filing a follow-up ticket: INFRA-3421 with logs and manifest diff. I'll attach trace IDs and pod logs.

carol: Customer impact note for CS: ~12% failed requests between 18:34:12-18:52:00 UTC affecting generation endpoint; we applied rollback at 18:43:20 and full recovery by 18:52:00. I'll craft a brief message for support.

sara: handing off to matt for monitoring during the rest of oncall window. If it flares again, escalate to SRE and consider draining node-gpupool-3 for deeper inspection.

matt: Acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and leave the incident open for postmortem. Thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "stabilized" at 2024-06-15T18:52:12Z. Please ensure postmortem is created within 48 hours.

matt: Creating postmortem now (PM-2024-06-15-inference-rollout-mount). Assigning to @vinh and @sara for remediation items.

carol: Closing customer comm draft pending review. Will publish after postmortem draft.

sara: quick note — we'll also add a small integration test that mounts the PVC in CI to catch this class of error. I'll add to INFRA-3421.

matt: Good work team. Leaving thread for follow-ups.
